title: Readiness Estimator: Brain Organoid Ethics Boards
definition: Estimates Brain Organoid Ethics Boards readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Brain Organoid Ethics Boards components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a board hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Brain Organoid Ethics Boards operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Brain Organoid Ethics Boards installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 21439 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where ethics frameworks monitoring, board logistics redundancy, or consciousness review maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Brain Organoid Ethics Boards Master Roadmap
title: Brain Organoid Ethics Boards Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Brain Organoid Ethics Boards: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Brain Organoid Ethics Boards — boards governing organoid research.

Phase 1 — Prove (ethics frameworks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (board logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (consciousness review): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (consent): board hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and research-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
